newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Petronas says expects crude at $18 per barrel.
newsitem.headline: Petronas says expects crude at $18 per barrel.

text.p: Malaysia's national oil company Petroliam Nasional Bhd (Petronas) said it expects crude oil price to average around $18 per barrel for the remainder of the year.
"I expect the (crude) oil price should be able to average $18 per barrel over the year. This would be an acceptable level," said Petronas President and Chief Executive Officer Hassan Marican.
He said crude prices had averaged around $22.29 per barrel for the year to March 31, 1997, compared to an average $18.86 a barrel in the previous financial year.
Marican was referring to Malaysian crude oils but did not specify which particular one he was referring to.
